race.comment: THATS ARCHIES GIRL (7) has been right there in all three runs this preparation and looks to be working up to another victory. Has placed over this course and distance and gets some weight relief with the 2kg claim. Rates the testing material. RHETORIC (4) hasn't been too far away of late and maps ideally for this from gate three. Include with winning rider Maloney back in the saddle. IMMEDIATE (6) has placed three of four here around this circuit and must be respected out of the Gollan yard. In the mix. SHE OURS (14) draws the inside marble and may earn some minor money.
